[IARC.4.2] Additional modules libds introduces beyond the
runtime-spec subsystem list — justified because the
runtime spec is topology-agnostic and these are
concrete integration surfaces:

| libds module | Why it exists |
|---|---|
| `dispatcher` | Action-verb routing — registers each verb as a native Rete builtin ([IRET.13]), holds the integrator-callback table for verbs that need one. No spec correspondence; it's the glue between the Rete network and the runtime spec's "dispatcher" concept. |
| `telemetry`  | Per-engine metric + log callback dispatch, a callback-based contract per [IARC.1.14]. |
| `schema`     | Per-engine schema registry. C-specific; not a separate runtime-spec subsystem. |
| `libds.h`   | Public API surface; no spec correspondence. |
